prompt.text:
Create exactly one native editable SVG stock asset that satisfies every requirement below.
Follow every requirement. Do not silently simplify, substitute, or omit constraints.
[SUBJECT]
- One standalone book
- Recognition anchors: rectangular closed-book silhouette; visible page block separated from the cover; clearly defined spine edge
- Essential components: front cover; back cover; spine; page block
- Proportions: credible everyday book proportions; page block slightly inset inside the cover edges
- Materials: paper page block; plain unbranded cover material
- Colors: limited harmonious stock-friendly palette; clear cover-to-page contrast
- Textures: minimal texture; clean flat vector surfaces without noisy grain
[COMMERCIAL]
- Primary use: editable isolated book vector for education, publishing, library, ecommerce and presentation design
- Buyer value: clean reusable object that can be recolored, resized and composed into many layouts
- Stock suitability: generic unbranded universally recognizable object with broad design utility and no contextual dependency
- Reusable contexts: education graphics; publishing layouts; library interfaces; ecommerce compositions; presentation diagrams
[COMPOSITION]
- Viewpoint: slight three-quarter view that clearly shows cover, spine and page block
- Composition: single object only; centered with generous transparent margin; complete silhouette fully visible with no crop; no scene or unrelated props
- Visual hierarchy: book silhouette reads first; spine and page block remain distinct at thumbnail size
[VECTOR_STYLE]
- Style system: clean contemporary stock vector; simple editable shapes; crisp geometry; subtle dimensional separation without photorealism
- Shape language: few purposeful paths and primitive shapes; closed clean contours; avoid microscopic decorative geometry
- Stroke policy: use no stroke unless a small structural edge requires one; keep any stroke simple and consistent
- Fill policy: use solid fills only with a compact palette and no bitmap textures
- Depth policy: express depth through overlapping shapes and restrained flat color separation, not filters or raster effects
- Native editable vector geometry is mandatory
[COMPLEXITY]
- SVG bytes <= 524288
- Geometry elements <= 256
- Total sampled points <= 4096
- Characters in any path d <= 16384
- Group depth <= 32
[RIGHTS_AND_STOCK]
- No logos or trademarks
- No copyrighted character/style imitation
- No readable text
- No watermark
- Additional forbidden content: logos; publisher marks; ISBN/barcode; branded cover art; copyrighted character imagery
[SVG_OUTPUT]
- Return genuine SVG source, not a traced/wrapped raster
- Transparent background; no background rectangle
- Allowed geometry elements: g; path; rect; circle; ellipse; line; polyline; polygon
- Allowed path commands: M; L; H; V; C; S; Q; T; A; Z
- Forbidden SVG features: script; external references; embedded raster image; foreignObject; text; style; defs; symbol; use
- Root svg must have a finite viewBox and contain editable visible geometry
[INVARIANTS]
- Every Blueprint requirement remains semantically binding downstream
- Master Instruction contains no provider/model/transport choice
- Provider prompt may change phrasing but may not weaken or omit a clause
- Mission/provider/submission/publication authority is not granted by compilation
Output only the complete raw <svg>...</svg> source, with no prose or Markdown.
